provenance.notes: Limits and rights unknown: navitia.io's terms page refused to be read on 2026-11-10 (HTTP 403), and SNCF's api.sncf.com publishes no quota. Copies of navitia.io's terms indexed elsewhere speak of a free tier of 5,000 requests a month, paid tiers above it and a credit to navitia.io with a link; Île-de-France Mobilités' own Navitia (PRIM) states 20,000 requests a day. None of this is declared until read at its source. The attribution option replaces the credit's text with what a coverage's data licence asks.
